description: rcf build verdict review and rcf build verdict test write ReviewVerdict and TestVerdict records under rcf/verdicts/<h12>/ for the reviewed head, committed by REVIEW: and TEST: commits. A failed verdict (REVIEW FINDINGS on code or test adequacy, or TEST FAIL) closes the round and the next commit starts a new round at DEFINE:. rcf audit separation enforces monotonic stage order within a round, allows a regression to DEFINE: only right after a failed verdict, and checks each verdict names the right head. The REVIEW verdict names the round's touched criteria.

title: REVIEW and TEST verdicts are recorded as branch commits and the separation audit judges stage order within a round
